summary: Tested new document download endpoint + delete-with-storage-cleanup + full lifecycle regression. 8/8 backend pytest tests passed (TXT/PDF/DOCX byte-identical downloads, 403 attendee, 404 nonexistent, delete removes DB row + list, full upload->parse->toggle->delete lifecycle, background AI parsing transitions to 'parsed'). Playwright UI verified: new download-doc-{id} button appears alongside toggle-doc-{id} and delete-doc-{id} on every DocCard; clicking it triggers a real browser download event with the correct suggested filename; toggle and delete continue to work exactly as before ('Document deleted' toast shown, list count drops).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/admin.py::download_document — content_type falls back to application/octet-stream when NULL; solid. However, if storage_path is present but storage fetch throws for a permission/network reason (not just 'not found'), the caller still gets 404 which conflates 'file missing' with 'transient storage error'. Low priority — consistent with the existing meetings audio pattern.

backend/routers/admin.py::delete_document — DB row is deleted BEFORE storage removal is attempted (best-effort). This matches the meetings.py audio pattern and is intentional (avoids blocking user on storage flakiness), but does mean any storage failure creates a fresh orphan. Mitigation is the same as the pre-fix audit finding — recommend a periodic reconciliation job long-term. Not blocking.

frontend/src/pages/AdminLibrary.js::handleDownloadDoc — creates a URL.createObjectURL but only revokes it AFTER a.click(). Since download is asynchronous some browsers may cancel; consider setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000). Very minor.
